title: There she sits, a grass widow, at the selfsame fireside. Believes me dead. Rocked in the cradle of the deep. And there sits uncle Chubb or Tomkin, as the case might be, the publican of the Crown and Anchor, in shirtsleeves, eating rumpsteak and onions
html_source: A grass widow is a woman whose husband is often away for long periods. This whole passage echoes Odysseus returning home to Penelope and finding her surrounded by suitors who are eating his food.
